item.title: PikaTorrent v0.15.0
item.description:
PikaTorrent 0.15.0 | PikaTorrent-v0.15.0-ios
- Improved streaming performance and reliability - Added playable files filter - Multi-selection support for bulk torrent deletion - Initial translations and localization support - Support for 16KB page sizes for Android - Bug fixes
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/G-Ray/pikatorrent/compare/v0.14.0...v0.15.0
